item.title: Deputy & K9 Arrest 2 After Traffic Stop
item.description: Knox County deputies made a drug-related arrest during a traffic stop Tuesday afternoon. Deputy Levi Archer stopped a minivan on South Hart Street Road near Stagecoach Road after a license plate reader flagged the driver as suspended.
